pairs.why: B's roses are smaller and painted flatter, so the finish is cleaner and less busy, closer to the smooth real cards; A's large embossed roses add surface detail.
A is the cleaner centred-rose version with flatter decoration, while B carries the busier, more embossed rose pattern that the lessons mark down as too texture-heavy.
